patterns.note: An extensive, dynamic grid layout for project showcases, blending various media types and aspect ratios to create visual interest and density.
Hierarchical typography with oversized, bold sans-serif headings for primary statements and smaller, clean sans-serif for body text and navigation.
High-contrast monochrome base (black, white, and grays) punctuated by a single vibrant accent color (green) for interactive elements and highlights.
The primary navigation header transforms on scroll, reducing its height and gaining a solid dark background as it becomes sticky at the top of the viewport.
The site prominently features a 'Capabilities' section presented as a multi-column list of services, clearly outlining their offerings.

technique_notes: The header transitions from a transparent, taller state to a compact, dark, sticky bar with a subtle border on scroll, providing persistent navigation.
Sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging scroll experience.
The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video background to add dynamic visual interest, overlaid with high-contrast text for readability.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-5x body text) with clean, legible body text and small, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a tighter, but well-padded, grid for project showcases.

standout: The site's standout feature is its immediate and extensive showcase of diverse projects in a dynamic, asymmetric grid. This approach, combined with bold, high-contrast typography and a minimal aesthetic, powerfully communicates their capabilities and expertise without relying on generic marketing imagery.
